# Rohan Pradyumna

> Founder, builder, and AI enthusiast based in Washington DC. Building products that turn messy requirements into working code.

## Who I Am

Rohan Pradyumna is an immigrant founder and software engineer from Hyderabad, India, now based in Washington DC. He is the founder of Yottaflex, where he builds AI-powered developer tools. Rohan is passionate about vibe coding, startups, and the intersection of AI and software development.

## What I Do

- **Building:** AI products that help developers ship faster
- **Writing:** Blog posts about startups, AI, vibe coding, and the immigrant founder experience
- **Interests:** Pickleball, specialty coffee, Stoic philosophy, working out

Rohan Pradyumna is a software engineer and startup founder specializing in AI developer tools. He writes about vibe coding, startups, and the immigrant founder experience.
